reverse_logistics_mgr.role: Used Engine Block, Transmission & Hydraulic Cylinder Core Returns from Global Dealers
reverse_logistics_mgr.summary: Orchestrates the global circular supply chain, reclaiming worn diesel engine blocks, cylinders, and tracks for remanufacturing.

demand_sensing_agent.systems: SAP S/4HANA · Cat Dealer Network Portal · Mining Equipment Utilization Feeds · BigQuery · TimesFM
demand_sensing_agent.problemDetails: Global mining commodity cycles, infrastructure stimulus bills, and dealer rental fleet utilization spikes create extreme boom-and-bust order swings across large excavator and bulldozer lines.
demand_sensing_agent.solutionDetails: Correlates global heavy construction bidding activity, mining commodity indexes, and Cat machine telematics (run hours, engine duty cycles) to forecast machine and parts replenishment.
demand_sensing_agent.outcomeDetails: Reduces dealer parts stockouts by 34%; unlocks $75M in excess finished machine buffer inventory.

reverse_logistics_mgr.systems: Cat Reman Core Management System · SAP S/4HANA Reverse · Heavy Logistics Network
reverse_logistics_mgr.problemDetails: Used diesel engine blocks, hydraulic cylinders, and transmissions (cores) sit in dealer scrap yards instead of returning to remanufacturing plants for circular re-machining.
reverse_logistics_mgr.solutionDetails: Tracks and incentives dealer core returns with automated core credit verification, dynamic backhaul freight allocation, and circular remanufacturing production planning.
reverse_logistics_mgr.outcomeDetails: Accelerates core turnaround by 26 days; remanufactures 140M lbs of heavy components annually while saving 85% of virgin raw steel.
